description:
Create a new, empty micropage project in the signed-in account and return it together with a complete starter .page file (one of the bundled examples) to adapt.

Use it when the user wants a new site. Each call creates another project and counts against the plan's project limit (Pro: 5, Pro+: 20), so check list_projects first when the user may mean an existing site. Nothing is published: write the page, call save_page, and publish only on request.

It does not write local files (it is not `micropage projects create`) and cannot set a custom domain; that is done in the editor.

domain.description: Optional micropage subdomain: "acme" serves at https://acme.micropage.sh. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 58 characters. Omit it to get one derived from the name plus a short random suffix.

name.description: Project name shown in the editor, e.g. "Acme waitlist".

name: create_project

domain.description: micropage slug: the site lives at https://<domain>.micropage.sh.

example.description: Which bundled example the starter source is.

referenced_files.description: Files the starter references with `<-`; upload them with upload_asset or remove those lines.

source.description: A complete .page file to adapt and pass to save_page as landing.page.

title: Create a micropage project
